topic: Interior Lighting Sub System Parameter Mapping
row_semantics: Lighting intensity levels or dimming settings for interior lights, represented by numerical codes (e.g., 5720, 5760)
column_semantics: The first column represents the specific lighting parameter code, while the second column indicates the corresponding brightness level or dimming percentage (ranging from 54 to 7). The remaining columns are empty and may be reserved for future parameters or additional data.

core_entities.name: Interior Lighting Sub System
core_entities.description: A subsystem responsible for controlling the illumination inside the vehicle, including ambient lighting, map lights, and other interior light sources.

core_conditions.name: Lighting Parameter Code
core_conditions.description: A unique numerical identifier for a specific lighting setting or configuration within the Interior Lighting Sub System.

core_conditions.name: Brightness Level
core_conditions.description: The intensity of the interior light, expressed as a percentage or a relative dimming value (e.g., 54%, 53%, down to 7%).

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the mapping between specific lighting parameter codes and their corresponding brightness levels for the Interior Lighting Sub System. It is used to verify that the system correctly interprets and applies the specified lighting settings during testing.
uncertain_points: The purpose of the empty columns beyond the second column is not explicitly defined in the visible content.
The exact functional behavior associated with each parameter code (e.g., which specific light or mode it controls) is not detailed in this table.
